turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Let me solve one example first, step by step.
I read books. My friend reads books.
Step 1: "My friend" is one person, like "he" or "she".
Step 2: so I add -s to the verb: read becomes reads.
Rule: after he, she, it or one person, add -s to the verb.
Right: He reads every day. Wrong: He read every day.
Now your turn. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
